name: LFM2.5-8B-A1B-GRPO-HotpotQA
context_scaling: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B (config.json max_position_embeddings 128000). This derivative does not publish a context-extension recipe of its own.
attention_variant: Inherited unchanged from LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B: 6 full GQA layers (kv heads 8, head_dim 64) and 18 other layers, per the base config.json.
notes: ADDED 2026-10-29. A finetune of LiquidAI/LFM2.5-8B-A1B, not a new base model: same config.json, same 8.468 parameters . Recorded as a contender because it publishes benchmark evidence against its own base; the evidence rows below are card-sourced and marked vendor_claim. Licence other, repo created 2026-10-15.

benchmarks.name: HotpotQA exact match (500 held-out hard questions)
benchmarks.config: Card table under 'On 500 held-out validation questions (all labelled hard), greedy:': row 'this model' 47.8% vs row 'LFM2.5-8B-A1B' 35.8%. Multi-turn research agent over ten Wikipedia articles with search/read/submit_answer tools; reward and metric are exact match on the submitted answer, not an LLM judge. LoRA r=32 merged into the weights.
